text: {"summary": "The script matches the contract on the main promises: the new-business self-service path, the card only after the tax number, no team filing, the 24–48 hour callback, the restricted mode, and no forbidden content (no product name, accountant name, or AI). The problems are mainly an unconditioned card step in L11 and a few omitted required details from the §26.7.4 outline.", "issues": [{"id": "L11", "severity": "medium", "issue": "The sentence states the card is given at the szerződés step without qualification. On the 'inditas' path the előfizetés is locked until the registration is 'kesz' (default policy adoszam_utan), so this contradicts the flow. L12 corrects it, but L11 is read first and misstates the order.", "evidence": "SPEC §26.1.6 (inditas locks: elofizetes locked until kesz), §26.1.7 (default adoszam_utan), §26.7.4 outline ('előfizetés (for new businesses only once the tax number exists)')", "fix": "Make L11 path-specific, e.g. \"Elfogadod a szerződést. A havidíjhoz a kártyádat adod meg – új vállalkozásnál csak a adószám után.\" or merge L11 and L12 into one correct sentence."}, {"id": "L13", "severity": "low", "issue": "The NAV-meghatalmazás is not identified as given in ONYA, which the outline requires. It is also not stated that it is given by the client themselves in the app-guided ONYA flow.", "evidence": "SPEC §26.7.4 (outline for 'bekotes': 'NAV-meghatalmazás given by you in ONYA with the in-app guide'); FUNKCIOK 4 (UJEGYKE in ONYA, lépésről lépésre útmutató)", "fix": "Rewrite L13 to: \"Ezután a NAV ONYA-felületén NAV-meghatalmazást adsz a könyvelődnek. Ebben lépésről lépésre segít az alkalmazás.\""}, {"id": "L09", "severity": "low", "issue": "The outline asks to say the self-registration takes a few minutes. The script omits this time expectation, which sets the user's expectation for the largest step. The 'few minutes' figure should stay consistent with the guide's 'Kb. 10–15 perc' label.", "evidence": "SPEC §26.7.4 (outline for 'bekotes': 'the app shows you step by step how to register it yourself in a few minutes'); §26.6.1 ('Kb. 10–15 perc')", "fix": "Add to L09 or L10: \"…te magad jelented be a NAV-nál, kb. tíz-tizenöt perc alatt.\""}, {"id": "L08", "severity": "low", "issue": "The outline says what the adataid are for (tax and cost ratio), and the script says only that the accountant calculates from them. The cost-ratio detail is missing.", "evidence": "SPEC §26.7.4 (outline: 'adataid (tax and cost ratio)'); FUNKCIOK 2 (költséghányad)", "fix": "Extend L08: \"Először az adataid kellenek, a adóval és a költséghányaddal együtt: ezekből számol a könyvelőd.\""}, {"id": "L19", "severity": "low", "issue": "\"Onnantól a könyvelőd szól, ha tenned kell valamit\" promises a notification behaviour that the feature list only supports as 'teendők a könyvelőtől' (accountant to-dos). It does not say that notifications come by push or that the csapat also answers.", "evidence": "FUNKCIOK 11 (Teendők a könyvelőtől), 18 (értesítés); SPEC §26.5.1 (todoCount)", "fix": "Soften to: \"Onnantól a könyvelőd kérésekben jelzi, ha tenned kell valamit, és ezt az appban látod.\""}]}
